canonicalDomains.label: Canonical Domains
canonicalDomains.hint: Domains from which recruiters legitimately send email. One per line.

recruitingChannels.label: Recruiting Channels
recruitingChannels.hint: Official channels (LinkedIn company page, careers site). HTTPS required.

applicationUrls.label: Application URLs
applicationUrls.hint: The only legitimate locations where candidates may apply. HTTPS required.

never.label: Never — Negative Assertions
never.hint: "We will never do these." At least one must be selected.
never.customHint: Kebab-case format (e.g. remote-fee). Custom tokens may not be auto-matched by all verifiers.

verifyContact.label: Verify Contact
verifyContact.hint: Official address to confirm a recruiter's legitimacy. mailto: or https://

verifiedRecruiters.label: Verified Recruiters
verifiedRecruiters.hint: Recruiters' public profile URLs. One per line.

expires.label: Expires
expires.hint: After this date, the file is considered "unverifiable". Last-Updated is set automatically.

statusValid: Valid Tier 0 file — ready to publish
footerNote: Place the file at /.well-known/hiring.txt on your domain with valid TLS over HTTPS. The verifier fetches from the canonical domain — not from the address the sender provided. Add Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * to the response headers.
